steps.what: Discuss programmes with prospective students and review registration or placement questions

tasks.design: Retain the teacher's programme explanation and academic placement contribution. Existing information in {DOCS} supports the discussion; no registrar data-entry workload is assigned to the teacher without observation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Individual interests and prior learning need explanation and judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: No new tool changes the personal contribution in this boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous prior qualifications and suitability require accountable academic advice.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher explains course demands and listens to the student's circumstances.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in participation time or admission authority.

evidence.claim: A teacher's recruitment and placement contribution can remain personal guidance rather than assumed bulk processing.

assumptions: Boundary is the teacher's participation, not registrar processing or final admission. Those roles retain their existing effort and authority.
Programme staff supply existing course information and applicants supply existing application materials upstream; neither is newly structured for automation. No machine input is required.
No implementation or new upkeep is proposed, so incremental hours are zero.
unknowns: Whether the teacher has a separate repetitive registration-entry duty
research_questions: Which observed registration activities are actually performed by the teacher?

already_counted.description: All programme guidance and placement contribution

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 with zero upkeep. Personal participation is unchanged and earns no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select specialised reading materials and verify editions, references and student access
Compile selected references into a consistently formatted bibliography
Check the complete bibliography and release the outside-reading assignment

tasks.design: Use a reference-manager category in {OTHER} to render the teacher's verified reading selection into {DOCS}. The teacher retains scholarly selection, access checks and release through {LMS}; no model invents or chooses references.
tasks.previous_blocker: Bibliographic entries are repeatedly typed and restyled.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference records and citation styles can render selected items consistently.
tasks.still_hard: The right edition, relevance and student access need checking.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher chooses readings that deepen the assignment.
tasks.altitude: Less citation transcription; scholarly selection remains the teacher's work.

evidence.claim: Native reference-manager records can render selected citations without generative title suggestions; the formatting share and savings are E1 scenarios.

assumptions: Boundary is one specialised reading list from selection through release, excluding authoring the underlying assignment.

Teacher produces author, title, edition, year, publisher, stable identifier, assigned pages and access location in s1; all capture and verification stays in its 55 hours. OTHER denotes a reference manager and catalogue. Incomplete records are formatted manually during s3.
Test native reference import and citation styles before custom code. Existing automatic citation rendering earns no new saving.
research_questions: Does rendering preserve the required editions and assigned page ranges without extra input work?

already_counted.description: Scholarly selection, metadata capture and access checks

incremental.description: Maintain citation style and inspect metadata-import errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact bibliography file, editions, assigned pages and access links; changes void release approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=70; gross 30 less 4 upkeep gives net 26. Low assumes citations already rendered natively with no change; high requires observed 30-hour manual formatting and no added metadata burden.

tasks.short: Take part in cultural and literary activities

steps.what: Participate in literary activities, travel and performing arts events to deepen cultural understanding

tasks.design: Keep attendance, travel and cultural engagement with the teacher. Existing programme notes may be read in {DOCS}, but the experience itself is unchanged.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cultural experience is gained through engagement and presence.
tasks.enabler_now: No software replaces that experience within this task.
tasks.still_hard: Interpretation depends on context, performance and personal attention.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher connects direct experience to literary understanding.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in cultural participation time.

reach.task: Discuss cultural context of literary performances

evidence.claim: Participation and travel remain personal experience; no booking or reporting baseline is inferred.

assumptions: Boundary is participation including travel, excluding travel booking and expense claims.
Event organisers provide existing programme information; no newly structured machine input is required.
No implementation or new upkeep is introduced, so incremental effort is zero.
unknowns: Type and duration of cultural activities
research_questions: Which experiences contribute to the teacher's subject knowledge?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and zero upkeep. No change to cultural participation means zero saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise student teaching, internships and research

steps.what: Review student teaching plans, internship evidence and research work before supervision
Supervise students through discussion, feedback and agreement on the next work

tasks.design: Retain direct review of the student's work in {DOCS} and the supervision conversation. No progress-note or assessment automation is assumed in this boundary.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision requires understanding the student's actual work.
tasks.enabler_now: No proposed change removes direct academic attention.
tasks.still_hard: Research choices, teaching difficulties and placement issues need contextual guidance.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher challenges reasoning and adapts support to the student.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in supervision time or academic authority.

evidence.claim: Direct review and supervision remain human work; no record-writing workload is presumed.

assumptions: Boundary is preparation and supervision, excluding final grading and placement administration.
Students produce their existing work and placement supervisors supply existing feedback upstream with unchanged effort. No machine step requires structured fields.
No deployment or new upkeep is introduced; incremental hours are zero.
research_questions: Is there a separately observed repetitive administrative duty outside the supervision interaction?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and zero upkeep; unchanged direct review and supervision yields zero saving.
